report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200; three of four were 62-78ms and one was 344ms, with no 5xx, no error logs, and no dependency-operation failures. The single elevated sample is not sufficient to establish any bounded root cause from the taxonomy; healthy telemetry contradicts a fault hypothesis. Handing off for baseline and per-dependency latency evidence before attributing a cause.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to judge whether 344ms is anomalous
Per-dependency latency breakdown (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) to localize the 344ms
Error/timeout logs or 5xx metrics during the slow request window
Saturation signals (CPU, connection pool wait, GC) for gateway and downstream services
